profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer and Manager, Information Security at Space Exploration Engineering
profile.jobTitle: Principal Software Engineer and Manager, Information Security.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer and Manager, Information Security.
positions.description:
- Work with product owners to understand desired application capabilities and testing scenarios - Continuously improve software engineering practices
- Work within teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions of development tools and technologies
- Lead the craftsmanship, availability, resilience, and scalability of solutions
- Contribute code to the development of multi-platform application systems, through local builds and deployments as well as CI environments
- Work to identify technical needs of systems and determine the priority of needs
- Update and maintain company website and social media sites.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · NIST 800-171/CMMC · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Microsoft Office · Visual Studio · Microsoft Azure · Atlassian JIRA · Python · Atlassian Confluence

positions.title: Software Engineer/Aerospace Engineer at Emergent Space Technologies/NASA Goddard Contractor
positions.description:
- Contractor at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center
- Aerospace engineer for mission simulation and analysis for the Restore mission (robotic servicing of geo-satellites). Now Restore-L for leo-satellites - Mission simulation software and sensor selection (testing and synthetic image generation/analysis).
 - Aerospace engineer for RAVEN mission, launched in 2017, - Mission simulation software, flight software, testing and analysis.

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.description: Aerospace engineer for modeling and simulation of active protection systems on ground based vehicles using Visual Basic and OpenGL.

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.description: Cell Culture Unit for the ISS - Thermal testing, Quality Assurance, Pro-Engineer certification, System simulation.

positions.title: Aerospace Engineer
positions.description: Aerospace engineer for modelling and simulation of counter measures and counter-counter measures within the National Missile Defense group.

positions.title: Engineering Internship/Co-op
positions.description: Naval Earth Map Observer (NEMO) spacecraft - Mission Simulation
